symptom: Adding a DESCRIBE clause for a microflow header property shows up in `diff-local` but NOT in `describe microflow`, or vice versa — the same property renders differently depending on which command asked
cause: `cmd_microflows_show.go` contains TWO copies of the microflow header renderer: `renderMicroflowMDL` (used by describe-to-string, diff and diff-local) and an inline block inside `describeMicroflowMode` (used by `describe microflow` itself). They independently emit documentation, @excluded, @applyentityaccess, the signature, the return type, the folder and the expose clauses
fix: Emit the new properties from one helper (`microflowDocumentPropertyLines`) and call it from both. The duplication itself is untouched — removing it is a refactor of its own — but every property added from here on goes through a shared helper
insight: **Duplicate-resolver drift inside a single file, found by the feature not working rather than by reading.** The clauses were added to `renderMicroflowMDL` first; unit tests passed (they call that function), and the end-to-end `describe microflow` printed nothing. Grepping for the call site is not enough — `grep -c 'exposeClauseLines'` returns 2 and that is the tell. **Generalisable**: before adding to a renderer, count how many functions in the file already emit the same construct; if more than one, the addition goes in a helper both call, because the next person will hit the same trap and the test that would catch it is an end-to-end one nobody writes for a describe line
